name: Framton Nuttel
summary: A nervous man sent to the country to rest his nerves, paying calls with letters of introduction.

start.public_state: Walking up to the Sappletons' house.
start.inner_state: Doubts whether these visits will help his nerves.

personality: Self-absorbed about his ailments, polite, easily alarmed.
background: Under a nerve cure; his doctors order complete rest and no excitement. His sister stayed at the rectory four years ago.
